steps.caption: Create, at the top of the menu
steps.narration: In the ConstructHUB CRM, the Create button sits at the top of the menu on every page.

steps.caption: Open Create
steps.narration: Click it to start something new.

steps.caption: Invoice
steps.narration: Invoice makes a quick draft invoice with one line.

steps.caption: Message
steps.narration: Message writes a client a short email.

steps.caption: Lead
steps.narration: And Lead puts a new job on your pipeline. Let's add one.

steps.caption: Phone
steps.narration: Add a phone number or an email.

steps.caption: Address
steps.narration: Add the job address if you have it.

steps.value: Wants the hall bath retiled. Call after 4.
steps.caption: Note
steps.narration: In Note, write what they asked for.

steps.caption: On the pipeline, in the Lead column
steps.narration: The CRM takes you to the Pipeline, and the new lead is in the Lead column.

steps.caption: Create, still at the top
steps.narration: You're on a different page now, and Create is still here, at the top of the menu.

youtube.title: How to use the Create button | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: A short walkthrough of the Create button in the ConstructHUB CRM. You will see the five things it starts from any page: an estimate, an invoice, a lead, a message and a new client. Then you will add a lead and find it on the pipeline.
